title: Exploratory Clinical Study on the Safety and Efficacy of Anti- CD19/BCMA CAR-NK Cell Injection for the Treatment of Refractory Pediatric Rheumatic Diseases
off: Exploratory Clinical Study on the Safety and Efficacy of Anti- CD19/BCMA CAR-NK Cell Injection for the Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Pediatric Rheumatic Diseases
sponsor: The Children's Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine

officials.a: The Children's Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine

conds: Pediatric Rheumatological Condition (i.e., Arthritis, SLE, Kawasaki's Disaese)
Connective Tissue Disease-associated Interstitial Lung Disease
summary: A single arm, open-label pilot study is designed to determine the safety and effectiveness of anti-CD19/BCMA CAR-NK cell injection in patients with refractory pediatric rheumatic diseases.

arms.d: Patients will receive Fludarabine and Cyclophosphamide on day-5, -4, and -3. Multiple doses of anti-CD19/BCMA CAR-NK cells (KN5601) will be administered using dose-escalation strategy.
